changelog:
- Removed the sample skill-card.md file.
- Expanded synchronization procedures to require scanning all README locations (including those for packages, modules, and deployments), with explicit exclusion of dependencies and build artifacts.
- Enhanced support and checks for multi-language/internationalized documentation, mandating consistency of key facts, filenames, scripts, and commands across all language entrypoints.
- Added new requirements for listing scanned and synced README/docs, specifying which language files were updated or require manual review.
- Broadened validation steps to include "old terminology search" and report/command/path consistency checks across documents.
